bio.text: Adriana Guzmán Fralick won the Republican nomination for Nevada Attorney General in the June 9, 2026 primary, defeating Douglas County Commissioner Danny Tarkanian.
She is an attorney with her own firm in Reno, focusing on personal injury and legal and political counsel.

She was previously general counsel to Gov. Jim Gibbons and an attorney for state agencies including the Nevada Commission on Ethics, the Public Utilities Commission of Nevada and the Nevada Gaming Control Board.
The race is her first run for public office.

sources.title: Nevada is set to have one of nation's premier races for governor as Democrats seek to reclaim seat
Guzmán Fralick, Tarkanian square off in Nevada Attorney General GOP primary
